evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/accounting/pages/PaymentMatchingPage.tsx:54,61,68 — all three financial-reconciliation mutations (uploadMutation=uploadStatement, confirmMutation=confirmMatch, rejectMutation=rejectMatch) declare only onSuccess (queryClient.invalidateQueries) and have NO onError handler; the page also never destructures isError/error from any mutation (grep 'onError' -> 0 hits in the file).
